metadata.title: Soft Glamour Portrait with Script Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus studio portrait featuring a seated subject, a large floral element, and elegant, sharp-edged script typography with a pink drop shadow.
triggerTerms: soft focus portrait with large rose
sharp script lettering with pink shadow
seated studio pose on gradient floor

recipe.visualDefinition: A seated woman in a blue garment is positioned in a soft-lit studio environment, flanked by a large pink rose on the left. The composition is framed by elegant, custom script lettering at the top and bottom, featuring a distinct pink drop shadow that creates a 3D effect against a muted, desaturated background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject seated centrally with a slight diagonal lean
Large floral element balancing the subject on the left
Typography framing the top-left and bottom-right corners
Soft, diffused lighting creating a hazy, romantic atmosphere
coreInvariants: Sharp-edged script typography with a contrasting pink drop shadow
Muted grey-blue studio background with a soft floor-to-wall transition
Presence of a large, soft-focus pink rose as a secondary focal point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated on the floor, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to full-body height within the square format.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large pink rose act as dual anchors, connected by the diagonal line of the subject's pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left script, moves down to the rose, across the subject's body, and finishes at the bottom-right script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper-right and lower-left, filled with a soft, smoky gradient.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted slate blue and grey (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and soft pink (rose and text shadow)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights on the skin and rose petals.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to desaturated cool tones for the environment

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick downstrokes and thin upstrokes
Sharp, needle-like terminals on ascenders and descenders
Letters are outlined in black with a offset pink drop shadow
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature elongated, sweeping flourishes
Lowercase 'l' and 't' have sharp, pointed tops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style used for both artist name and title to maintain elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant flourishes of the original lettering.
Provides the formal script structure required for the 80s look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a woman seated on a grey-blue floor against a gradient background, with a large pink rose to her left. Use diffused lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom script lettering in the top-left and bottom-right corners using black fill and a soft pink drop shadow offset to the right.

verificationChecks: Is the text sharp and calligraphic?
Does the pink shadow provide a 3D effect?
Is the lighting soft and diffused across the scene?
Is the rose large and slightly out of focus?

avoid: Harsh shadows on the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script has sharp, pointed terminals.
Ensure the pink shadow is consistently offset.
Verify the rose does not overpower the subject.
Confirm the overall color palette is muted and cool-toned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft Studio Portrait + Large Floral Prop + Sharp Script with Pink Shadow
